title.rendered: Board of Directors Executive Session/Special Meeting – June 24, 2024

content.rendered:
The Sherwood School District Board of Directors will be holding an Executive Session and Special Meeting on Monday, June 24, 2024; the meeting agenda can be found here. Please note: The Special Meeting will be an online-only meeting and can be viewed via live stream on the District’s YouTube channel at https://bit.ly/39VlhD3.

  • 11:30am – Executive Session (non-public meeting)
  • 12:00pm – Special Meeting (public meeting – online only)

Public comment for this meeting can be provided via online submission. To electronically submit written public comment for this meeting, please complete the form here. Electronic  submission of public comment will be accepted until 11:15am on Monday, June 24, 2024.  During the meeting, all electronically submitted public comment will be read aloud by the Board Secretary, up to three minutes in length per comment. Anonymous comments will not be read. 

The purpose of public comment is for members of our Board of Directors to hear public concerns, comments, and opinions.  Board members will not respond to submitted public comment.
